questions.title: Real-Time Log Watcher (tail -f)
questions.question: Build a tail -f style log watcher: a server process on the machine holding an append-only (possibly multi-GB) log file streams new lines to a web client at /log. The page loads once, shows the last 10 lines and then updates in real time without refresh; it must serve many clients, send only deltas, and not use off-the-shelf tail libraries. Evaluated on code quality, modularity, testability and edge cases (efficient last-10-lines read from the file end, pushing via WebSockets, file rotation).
